original_title: Invited Papers published in the Journal of Visualization
original_content_full:
Two extended papers are accepted for publication in the Springer Journal of Visualization:

- Daniel Limberger, Willy Scheibel, Jürgen Döllner, and Matthias Trapp: "Visual Variables and Configuration of Software Maps". DOI: 10.1007/s12650-022-00868-1

- Daniel Limberger, Willy Scheibel, Jan van Dieken, Jürgen Döllner: "Procedural Texture Patterns for Encoding Changes in Color in 2.5D Treemap Visualizations". DOI: 10.1007/s12650-022-00874-3
